stories.title: Malaysian PM Anwar’s National Day address moved indoors due to haze
stories.summary: Malaysia’s 2026 National Day Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s address has been moved indoors to the Putrajaya International Convention Centre due to haze conditions. The move aims to ensure safety, health, comfort, and smooth running of the event without affecting the celebration’s spirit. Decisions on the National Day parade will depend on health and environmental assessments, with the public advised to stay updated on haze developments. Malaysia’s 2026 National Day Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s Address, scheduled for Aug 30 at 9.30pm, has been moved from Dataran Merdeka to the Putrajaya International Convention Centre (PICC) due to haze, says the country’s Communications Ministry. The ministry said the decision was made as an adaptive measure in view of current conditions, particularly to ensure the safety, health and comfort of guests and the public, as well as the smooth running of the event. “The relocation will not affect the programme or spirit of the 2026 National Day celebrations, but is instead a responsible measure to ensure the event is held in a more controlled and comfortable environment,” it said in a statement on Aug 27. The statement said the Federal Government will continue to monitor the haze situation and air quality from time to time. Meanwhile, a decision on whether the National Day 2026 parade will proceed will be made based on the prevailing situation, as well as assessments and advice from the Health Ministry, Environment Department and Malaysian Meteorological Department.

stories.title: ICE agents in US to be equipped with pain-delivering electric shock gloves
stories.summary: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement has awarded a US$16.7 million contract to purchase 6,000 pairs of gloves that can deliver painful electric shocks, saying officers would use them to control detainees and protesters who resist. ICE moved forward with the purchase despite opposition from civil rights advocates and Democratic members of Congress, who said ICE officers cannot be trusted to use them appropriately. A notice published in a federal database Thursday said ICE entered into a no-bid...
